description: Persists CareerCompass data to the user's GigHQ profile. This REPLACES the full saved record — any array field you omit (technical_skills, soft_skills, management_skills, target_industries, company_size, geographic_location, other_skills) is saved as empty, not left unchanged. Call get_career_compass first and pass through every field the user isn't changing. Only call this after the user has reviewed the content (e.g. from generate_career_compass) and explicitly authorized saving it.

company_size.description: Target company sizes. Omitting this clears any previously saved company sizes.

geographic_location.description: Target geographic locations. Omitting this clears any previously saved locations.

is_complete.description: Defaults to true server-side. Pass false only for an explicit partial/in-progress save.

management_skills.description: Management skills. Omitting this clears any previously saved management skills.

objective_suggestions.description: The AI-generated objective candidates shown to the user, so a resumed session can show the same options.

other_skills.description: Other skills. Omitting this clears any previously saved other skills.

progress_step.description: Wizard step reached, for an in-progress save (is_complete: false).

soft_skills.description: Soft skills. Omitting this clears any previously saved soft skills.

target_industries.description: Target industries. Omitting this clears any previously saved target industries.

target_industry.description: Single primary target industry, distinct from the target_industries list.

technical_skills.description: Technical skills. Omitting this clears any previously saved technical skills.

name: save_career_compass
